commands.name: destroy

options.name: --purge-config
options.description: Also delete ~/.flare/ entirely (including .env  credentials), not just the data volumes. A follow-up `flare start`  regenerates fresh credentials.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation prompt. Required for non-interactive use.

commands.description: Remove containers AND data volumes. Destructive - requires --yes.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Run read-only diagnostics against Docker and the stack.

options.name: --follow
options.description: Stream logs instead of printing a fixed tail.

arguments.name: SERVICE
arguments.description: Which service to show logs for (clickhouse, redis,  ingest, api, dashboard). Omit for all.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open the dashboard in your default browser.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start the standing Flare stack (first run also initializes ~/.flare/).

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the stack without removing data volumes - a pause,  not a teardown.

commands.name: tail

options.name: --level
options.description: Filter by severity: trace, debug, info, warn, error,  fatal. Repeatable.

options.name: --search
options.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the log  body.

options.name: --service
options.description: Filter by exact service name (e.g. flare-ingest).  Repeatable.

commands.description: Live-tail structured log events (filterable by  service/level/trace/search).

commands.name: update
commands.description: Pull the latest images for the pinned tag and recreate  containers.
